subtasks.subgoal: move the black gripper to the green block
subtasks.description: Approach and descend with the black gripper open, until ready to grasp the green block. Keep the white arm still.

subtasks.subgoal: grasp and lift the green block with the black gripper
subtasks.description: Close the black gripper on the green block and lift it clear of the table before horizontal transport.

subtasks.subgoal: move the held green block to the right of the red block
subtasks.description: Carry the held green block above the destination on the right of the red block. Do not move the red block.

subtasks.subgoal: place the green block to the right of the red block, release it and withdraw the black gripper
subtasks.description: Lower the green block onto the table, open the black gripper, withdraw, and hold until stable. Do not infer completion from the dataset's success flag.
